Tariq moved the torch to the blue drawer. He told Bruno it was in the white cabinet to mislead him, so Tariq still believes it is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: B

Tariq moves the torch to the blue drawer. His text to Bruno is a lie and doesn’t change where the torch is.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru’s last information came from the two texts telling her the torch was in the grey locker. She didn’t learn about either later move, so she opens the grey locker first.

ANSWER: C

Wanjiru left the garage before the later moves. Both texts she received said the torch was in the grey locker, and she received no further updates.

ANSWER: C

Xavier and Rania are both in the garage when Tariq moves the torch to the blue drawer. Xavier knows Rania saw the move. Tariq’s later text went only to Bruno, so Xavier thinks Rania still believes the torch is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: B

Rania saw Bruno move the torch to the black trunk. Bruno left before Tariq moved it again, and Rania doesn’t know about Tariq’s private text to Bruno. So she thinks Bruno still believes the torch is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Rania waits beside the black trunk. She knows Bruno put the torch there and left before Tariq moved it. She doesn’t know about Tariq’s private text, so she expects Bruno to open the black trunk, even though he’ll actually open the white cabinet.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru’s move in step 8 put the workshop in Room Dogwood. Oksana’s message in step 9 did not change the booking.

ANSWER: C

Xavier hears Wanjiru move the workshop to Room Dogwood in step 8. Oksana’s later message goes only to Amara, so Xavier still believes the workshop is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: A

Amara moves the workshop to Room Birch and isn’t on the call when Wanjiru moves it to Room Dogwood. She believes Oksana’s later private message saying it’s in Room Fir.

ANSWER: B

Bruno texted Wanjiru that the torch was in the grey locker. Wanjiru knew Bruno expected her to read and believe his message, so she thought Bruno believed she thought it was in the grey locker. Nothing Bruno learned later gave him reason to think that Wanjiru’s view of his belief had changed.

ANSWER: D

Amara moves the workshop to Room Birch, then misses the move back to Room Dogwood because she isn’t on that call. She believes Oksana’s later message saying it’s booked in Room Fir, so she honestly answers “Room Fir.”

ANSWER: B

When Wanjiru left, the last place she had seen the torch was the blue drawer. Bruno knows his text to Wanjiru was private, and he doesn’t know that Rania secretly read Xavier’s text. So Bruno thinks Rania still believes Wanjiru thinks the torch is in the blue drawer. Tariq’s text changes Bruno’s own belief about the torch, not what he thinks Rania believes about Wanjiru.

ANSWER: D

Wanjiru saw Amara move the workshop to Room Birch. Amara was not on the call when Wanjiru moved it back to Room Dogwood, and Wanjiru does not know about Oksana’s private message. So Wanjiru thinks Amara still believes the workshop is booked in Room Birch.

ANSWER: C

Wanjiru saw Amara move the workshop to Room Birch. Amara wasn’t on the call when Wanjiru moved it back to Dogwood, and Wanjiru doesn’t know about Oksana’s private message. So Wanjiru expects Amara to say “Room Birch.”

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru moved the workshop to Room Dogwood while Oksana was on the call, so Wanjiru thinks Oksana knows it is booked there. Oksana’s later private message to Amara does not change what Wanjiru thinks.

ANSWER: D

Bruno last saw Tariq leave when the torch was in the grey locker. Tariq was absent when Bruno moved it to the black trunk and told Rania and Xavier. So, as far as Bruno knows, Rania thinks Xavier still takes Tariq to believe the torch is in the grey locker.

Bruno misses Tariq’s later move to the blue drawer, and Tariq’s private text to Bruno doesn’t update what Bruno thinks Rania or Xavier knows.

ANSWER: B

Chidi saw that the marble was in the green cupboard before leaving. Chidi missed Ines moving it to the red box, and nothing after Chidi’s return revealed the marble’s new location.

ANSWER: B

Xavier saw that Tariq was absent when Bruno moved the torch to the black trunk and announced its location. From Xavier’s perspective, the last location Tariq saw Bruno learn was the grey locker. Tariq’s later text to Bruno was private, so it doesn’t change Xavier’s belief about what Tariq thinks Bruno knows.

ANSWER: C

Ines moves the marble to the red box, and nobody moves it after that. Amara’s text changes what Zoltan believes, not where the marble is.

ANSWER: B

Tariq knows Xavier and Rania saw him move the torch to the blue drawer. As far as Tariq can tell, Wanjiru also thinks it’s in the blue drawer: that’s where she last saw it, and Tariq doesn’t know about the private texts she received. Bruno, however, believes Tariq’s text saying it’s in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: Bruno

Chidi saw that the marble was in the green cupboard. He was outside when Ines moved it to the red box, and nobody told him it had moved. So he opens the green cupboard first.

ANSWER: B

On call 8, Wanjiru moves the workshop to Room Dogwood. Xavier, Dalia, and Wanjiru all hear the change and can see that the others are on the call. So Xavier thinks that Dalia thinks that Wanjiru thinks Xavier believes the booking is in Room Dogwood. Oksana’s later private message to Amara doesn’t change that.

ANSWER: B

Amara last knew the workshop was in Room Birch, where she booked it herself. She missed the later move to Dogwood. When Oksana messages her that it’s in Room Fir, Amara believes her. Since Oksana knows Amara read the message, Amara thinks Oksana expects her to believe the booking is in Room Fir.

ANSWER: D

Ines moved the marble to the red box herself. She didn’t see Amara’s private text to Zoltan, so her belief didn’t change.

ANSWER: D

On call 7, Amara moves the workshop to Room Birch, and she sees that Oksana is there. So Amara thinks Oksana believes it is in Birch.

Dalia and Oksana both see that Amara is absent from call 8, when the workshop moves back to Dogwood. As far as Dalia knows, Oksana therefore still expects Amara to think Oksana believes it is in Birch. Dalia does not know about Oksana’s private message to Amara.

ANSWER: C

On call 7, Amara moves the workshop to Room Birch and sees that both Oksana and Dalia are present. So Amara thinks Oksana knows that Dalia heard the change to Birch.

Amara misses the later move to Dogwood. Oksana’s private message makes Amara believe the booking is in Fir, but it tells her nothing about what Oksana thinks Dalia knows. That nested belief stays at Room Birch.

ANSWER: C

Ines saw Chidi learn that the marble was in the green cupboard. He was outside when Ines moved it to the red box, and he received no update after returning. So Ines thinks Chidi still believes it is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: C

Amara believes the workshop is in Room Fir after reading Oksana’s private message. She takes Oksana to believe that too. Amara missed the later move to Dogwood, so as far as she knows, Xavier, Wanjiru, and Dalia still believe it’s in Room Birch.

ANSWER: Xavier, Wanjiru, Dalia

Hana moves the team offsite to Turin in the final call. No later event changes it.

ANSWER: D

Zoltan last saw the marble in the green cupboard, and he knows Mirela saw it there too. Amara’s private text changes what Zoltan believes about the marble’s location, but not what he thinks Mirela believes. Mirela’s text tells him only about the token. So he expects Mirela to open the green cupboard first.

ANSWER: D

Chidi saw the marble in the green cupboard before he left. Ines saw him leave and moved the marble to the red box while he was gone. Mirela witnessed all of this, so she thinks Ines still believes that Chidi thinks the marble is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: A

After Chidi returns, he and Ines both see Amara move the token to the flat tin. Ines knows that Chidi sees her witness the move, so she thinks Chidi knows that she knows where Amara believes the token is.

ANSWER: B

Nadim hears the offsite move to Graz in step 2 and hears Hana confirm Graz while secretly listening in step 6. He doesn’t hear about the later move to Turin, so he still believes the offsite is in Graz.

ANSWER: C

Nadim heard the offsite move to Graz and later heard Hana confirm it. He didn’t hear about the final move to Turin, so he says Graz.

ANSWER: D

Viktor is on the final call when Hana moves the offsite to Turin, so he believes it is in Turin.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan saw that Mirela was present when he opened the containers and revealed the marble in the green cupboard. He missed Ines moving it to the red box. Amara’s private text changed Zoltan’s own belief about the marble, but it didn’t tell him anything about what Mirela believed. So he still thinks Mirela believes it is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan left before Amara brought out the token. Mirela’s private text tells him it is in the flat tin, but it doesn’t tell him that Ines saw it being moved. So although Ines knows where the token is, Zoltan thinks she has no idea.

ANSWER: E

Mirela and Amara both saw Zoltan witness the marble being moved to the green cupboard. Zoltan was gone when Ines moved it back to the red box. Mirela doesn’t know about Amara’s private text, and her own text to Zoltan was only about the token. So Mirela thinks Amara still believes Zoltan thinks the marble is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: D

Hana knows Nadim heard her set the offsite in Ghent. She doesn’t know he heard either announcement about Graz, and he isn’t on the call when she moves the offsite to Turin. So Hana thinks Nadim still believes it’s in Ghent.

ANSWER: C

Viktor knows Nadim heard Xavier move the offsite to Graz. Nadim wasn’t on the final call when Hana moved it to Turin, and Viktor has no reason to think Nadim learned about that change. So Viktor thinks Nadim still believes the offsite is in Graz.

ANSWER: D

Hana expects Nadim to say **Ghent**. She knows he heard the original decision, but she doesn’t know that he heard the move to Graz or secretly listened in when she repeated it. Nadim actually believes the offsite is in Graz, but Hana has no reason to expect that answer.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan believes Amara’s text that the marble is in the wooden chest. Since Zoltan doesn’t suspect a lie, Zoltan takes Amara to believe that too.

As far as Zoltan knows, Ines, Chidi, and Mirela still believe the marble is in the green cupboard, where they all saw it when Zoltan opened the containers. Mirela’s later text was only about the token.

ANSWER: Ines, Chidi, Mirela

The last move is Goran putting the padlock in the wooden chest. Quinn doesn’t notice, but that doesn’t change where it is.

ANSWER: A

Viktor booked the client workshop in Room Elm on a call with Xavier and Hana. Everyone on the call heard the booking and could see who else was there. So Xavier believes Viktor knows that Hana heard Viktor make the booking and therefore thinks Viktor believes it is in Room Elm. Nothing later changes the workshop room.

ANSWER: B

Nadim believes the workshop is booked in Room Elm. Viktor told him that, and Nadim told Ines, so he knows both already share his view. Nadim did not hear the booking call and has no way to know that Xavier and Hana heard the booking.

ANSWER: Xavier, Hana

Xavier thinks Nadim last heard Hana set the offsite location to Ghent. Nadim heard Xavier move it to Graz, but Hana wasn’t on that call. Xavier doesn’t know Nadim secretly heard Hana say “Graz,” and Nadim wasn’t on the call where Hana moved it to Turin. So Xavier thinks Nadim still believes Hana thinks the offsite is in Ghent.

ANSWER: C

Viktor saw that both Xavier and Nadim were on the call when Xavier moved the offsite to Graz. Nadim wasn’t on the final call when Hana moved it to Turin, and Xavier has no reason to think Nadim learned about that change. So Viktor thinks Xavier believes Nadim still thinks the offsite is in Graz.

ANSWER: B

Nadim learns from Viktor that the workshop is booked in Room Elm. But he wasn’t on the call where Viktor booked it, and nothing Nadim hears or is told indicates that Hana knows the room. So Nadim thinks Hana has no idea which room it’s booked in.

ANSWER: E

Nadim’s last update was Goran’s text saying the padlock was in the white cabinet. Nadim neither saw nor was told about the later move to the wooden chest.

ANSWER: C

Mirela doesn’t know Ines missed the move to the green cupboard, so she thinks Ines saw Amara and Zoltan witness that move. Zoltan was out of the workshop when Ines moved the marble back to the red box, and neither Mirela nor Ines knows about Amara’s private message. So Mirela thinks Ines would expect Amara to believe that Zoltan still thinks the marble is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: B

Nadim last learned the padlock’s location from Goran’s text saying it was in the white cabinet. Nadim did not see the final move to the wooden chest and wasn’t told about it, so he opens the white cabinet first.

ANSWER: D

Viktor watches through the window as Goran moves the padlock to the wooden chest, so he believes it is there.

ANSWER: C

Viktor thinks Nadim still believes that Viktor thinks Hana has Ghent in mind. Nadim was on the call when Xavier moved the offsite to Graz, but Hana wasn’t. Viktor told Hana privately, and he doesn’t know that Nadim secretly heard Hana confirm Graz. Nadim also missed the final call, when Hana moved the offsite to Turin.

ANSWER: A

In step 12, Jonas reassigns the Marlow account to Osaka. Chidi misses the announcement, but that doesn’t change the assignment.

ANSWER: C

Viktor texts Bruno that the padlock is in the white cabinet and knows Bruno reads the message. Viktor sees Goran move it to the wooden chest afterward, but has no reason to think Bruno learned about that move. So Viktor thinks Bruno still believes it’s in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: B

Dalia believes the account is with Lisbon after Goran’s message, but Chidi’s later message updates her belief to Nairobi. She isn’t on the final call and isn’t told about the change to Osaka.

ANSWER: B

Bruno’s last information about Goran’s belief comes from Goran’s text saying the padlock is in the leather bag. Viktor later tells Bruno it is in the white cabinet, but doesn’t tell him what Goran believes.

ANSWER: B

Viktor watches Goran move the padlock to the wooden chest. Quinn misses the move, but nobody realizes that. So Viktor thinks Goran believes Quinn saw the move and thinks the padlock is in the wooden chest.

ANSWER: D

The last update Dalia receives is Chidi’s message saying the account is with the Nairobi office. She doesn’t learn about the later reassignment to Osaka, so she honestly says Nairobi.

ANSWER: C

Uma hears Jonas reassign the Marlow account to Osaka on the final call, so that replaces her earlier belief that it was with Nairobi.

ANSWER: B

Nadim believes the padlock is in the white cabinet because Goran told him so. As far as Nadim knows, Goran shares that belief, while Quinn, Viktor, and Bruno still believe the padlock is in the leather bag.

ANSWER: Quinn, Viktor, Bruno

Uma hears Jonas reassign the Marlow account to Osaka on the final call, so she thinks Jonas believes it is with the Osaka office.

ANSWER: B

Nadim and Viktor both saw Nadim move the padlock to the leather bag, and Quinn saw that they both witnessed the move. That was the last location Quinn knew they shared. Quinn did not know about the later private messages or Viktor’s watching through the window, so neither changes the nested belief.

ANSWER: A

Nadim saw Bruno watch Quinn move the padlock to the wicker basket, and Goran was there too. Nadim later told Bruno it was in the leather bag, but that text was private. Nadim also doesn’t know about the other texts Bruno received. So as far as Nadim knows, Goran still thinks Bruno believes the padlock is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: C

Bruno waits beside the leather bag. Goran’s text told Bruno where Goran believed the padlock was. Viktor’s later text updates Bruno’s own belief to the white cabinet, but it doesn’t tell him what Goran knows. Bruno doesn’t see Goran’s final move, so he still expects Goran to open the leather bag first.

ANSWER: A

Dalia takes Goran’s private message at face value, so she thinks he believes the account is in Lisbon. Chidi later tells her it is in Nairobi, which updates her own belief but tells her nothing about what Goran believes.

ANSWER: D

On call 9, Uma sees Goran and Jonas both hear the reassignment to Nairobi. Goran is absent from the final call, so Uma has no reason to think Jonas believes Goran learned about the move to Osaka.

ANSWER: C

Bruno’s final move puts the compass in the round tin, and nobody moves it afterward.

ANSWER: D

Uma put the compass in the flat tin. She missed Bruno moving it to the striped tin and left before he moved it to the round tin, so she still thinks it’s in the flat tin.

ANSWER: A

Uma last saw the compass when she put it in the flat tin. She missed Bruno moving it to the striped tin and had already left when he moved it to the round tin. So she opens the flat tin first.

ANSWER: C

Dalia expects Goran to say **the Lisbon office**. That’s what Goran told her, and she doesn’t know he was trying to mislead her. Chidi’s later message changes Dalia’s own belief to Nairobi, but it doesn’t tell her that Goran also knows about the Nairobi reassignment.

ANSWER: B

Bruno moves the compass to the round tin himself, and nothing afterward changes his belief about its location.

ANSWER: A

Viktor tells Bruno that the padlock is in the white cabinet. Bruno believes him and knows that Viktor knows he read the message. So Viktor thinks Bruno expects Viktor to know that Bruno believes it is in the white cabinet.

Viktor sees the final move to the wooden chest, but Bruno doesn’t know about the move or that Viktor saw it. That leaves the nested belief unchanged.

ANSWER: A

Bruno doesn’t realize Uma missed his move to the striped tin. She leaves before he moves the compass to the round tin, so he thinks she still believes it’s in the striped tin.

ANSWER: B

Dalia believes the account is with Nairobi because of Chidi’s message. As far as she knows, Jonas and Chidi both believe it’s with Nairobi because they each told her so, and Uma believes it’s with Nairobi because Dalia told her. Goran told Dalia it was with Lisbon, and she has no newer information about what he believes.

ANSWER: Goran

Bruno waits beside the striped tin. Uma missed his move from the flat tin to the striped tin, but Bruno doesn’t know she missed it. Since Uma left before he moved the compass to the round tin, Bruno expects her to open the striped tin first.

ANSWER: C

On call 9, Chidi and Uma both hear the account reassigned to Nairobi, and both see that Goran is on the call. So Chidi thinks Uma expects him to know that Goran believes the account is with Nairobi.

The final reassignment to Osaka doesn’t change that: Goran isn’t on the call, and Chidi misses the reassignment.

ANSWER: B

Farah saw Uma witness the stopwatch being moved to the black trunk. Farah later learns that the stopwatch was moved to the canvas sack, but she doesn’t learn that Uma was told about or saw that move. So Farah still thinks Uma believes it’s in the black trunk.

ANSWER: B

Farah left the study before Bruno first put the compass in a tin. She didn’t see any of its later moves, and the only messages she read were about the stopwatch. So she has no idea where the compass is.

ANSWER: E

Uma and Bruno both saw Rania witness the compass being put in the striped tin. Rania was out of the study when Uma moved it to the flat tin, so Uma thinks Bruno still believes Rania thinks it’s in the striped tin. Uma doesn’t witness the later move to the round tin.

ANSWER: B

Mirela switches the packaging supplier to Brightwater in step 9. Nothing changes the supplier after that.

ANSWER: B

Bruno switched the packaging supplier to Sablewood in step 7. He wasn’t on either of the later calls where the supplier changed, so he still thinks it’s Sablewood.

ANSWER: C

The last time Uma saw Dalia and Chidi receive the same assignment was when Jonas assigned Marlow to Denver. Uma missed the Osaka reassignment on the next call.

Dalia later tells Uma that Marlow is with Nairobi, but she doesn’t say what Chidi believes. Uma doesn’t know that Chidi told Dalia about Nairobi, and Dalia isn’t on the final call. So Uma still thinks Dalia thinks Chidi believes the account is with Denver.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan hears Soren reassign the Marlow account to Nairobi on the second-to-last call, then to Osaka on the final call. The final reassignment replaces his earlier belief.

ANSWER: D

Bruno last heard that the supplier was Sablewood on the call where he switched it. He wasn’t on either of the calls where Mirela later changed the supplier, so he honestly says “Sablewood.”

ANSWER: A

Farah saw everyone, including Rania and Bruno, watch her move the stopwatch to the black trunk. The later texts tell Farah that the stopwatch is in the canvas sack, but they don’t tell her that Bruno knows this or that Rania thinks he does. So Farah still thinks Rania believes Bruno thinks it’s in the black trunk.

ANSWER: C

Uma moved the compass to the flat tin while Bruno was in the study. She missed Bruno’s move back to the striped tin and had already left when he moved it to the round tin.

So, from Uma’s perspective, both she and Bruno saw the compass go into the flat tin, and both saw that the other was there. Following the chain of beliefs still leads to the flat tin.

ANSWER: C

Soren heard Bruno switch the packaging supplier to Sablewood. Bruno was absent from both later calls where Mirela changed it, so Soren thinks Bruno still believes it is Sablewood.

ANSWER: C

Rania privately tells Viktor that the compass is in the striped tin. She knows he reads the message, and she expects him to know that she knows he read it. So Rania thinks Viktor believes that she takes him to think the compass is in the striped tin.

Rania later sees Bruno move the compass to the round tin, but Viktor is not told about that move. It changes Rania’s own belief about the compass’s location, not the nested belief in the question.

ANSWER: A

The only Marlow assignment Zoltan saw Rania hear was the original assignment to Lisbon. He wasn’t on the Denver call, didn’t see Mirela’s private message to Rania, and saw that Rania was absent from the final two calls. So he thinks Rania still believes the account is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: D

On the final call, Soren reassigns the Marlow account to Osaka. Zoltan hears the reassignment and knows that Soren saw him on the call. So Zoltan thinks Soren knows that Zoltan believes the account is with Osaka.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan expects Rania to say **the Lisbon office**. Lisbon was the last assignment he knew Rania had heard. Rania’s private message from Mirela changed her belief to Osaka, but Zoltan didn’t know about it.

ANSWER: C

Uma’s last known shared update with both Dalia and Goran was the initial Denver assignment. Uma missed the Osaka reassignment on the second call, and she doesn’t know Dalia secretly heard the Osaka readout on the third call.

Dalia’s later message tells Uma the account is with Nairobi, but it says nothing about what Goran believes. So Uma still thinks Dalia thinks Uma takes Goran’s belief to be Denver.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan was not on any call where the packaging supplier was named, and nobody told him who it was.

ANSWER: E

Bruno’s final move puts the compass in the wicker basket. Nothing moves it after that.

ANSWER: D

Viktor believes the stopwatch is in the canvas sack. As far as he knows, Rania and Bruno both saw Rania put it there: Rania moved it herself, and Viktor didn’t realize Bruno missed the move. Viktor also knows Farah read his final text telling her it was in the sack.

Uma was out of the study during the move to the sack. Viktor didn’t see the later move back to the black trunk, so as far as he knows, Uma still believes it’s in the trunk.

ANSWER: Uma

Emeka sees Bruno move the compass to the grey locker through the window. He does not see the final move to the wicker basket, so he opens the grey locker first.

ANSWER: B

Emeka sees Bruno move the compass to the grey locker through the window. He does not see the final move to the wicker basket, so he still thinks it is in the grey locker.

ANSWER: A

Oksana misses an earlier move, but she sees Bruno’s final move to the wicker basket. That updates her belief.

ANSWER: D

Zoltan heard the final reassignment to Osaka, and saw that Mirela and Soren were on the call. As far as Zoltan knows, Bruno and Rania still believe the account is with Lisbon, the last assignment he heard with them present.

ANSWER: Bruno, Rania

Rania saw Zoltan hear the Lisbon assignment on the first call and saw that he was absent when the account moved to Denver. Soren and Mirela were on both calls, so as far as Rania knows, Soren thinks Mirela still takes Zoltan’s belief to be Lisbon.

Mirela’s private message about Osaka doesn’t tell Rania that Zoltan learned anything new, and Rania wasn’t on either of the later reassignment calls.

ANSWER: A

Uma last saw Emeka in the boathouse when the compass was in the green cupboard. She doesn’t know about his private texts or what he saw through the window, so she thinks he still believes it’s in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: C

Rania last heard the Marlow account assigned on a call with both Mirela and Soren when it went to Denver. Mirela’s later private message tells Rania that the account is in Osaka, but it doesn’t tell her that Soren knows that. So Rania still thinks Mirela thinks Soren believes the account is in Denver.

ANSWER: A

Rania takes Mirela’s private message at face value: she believes Mirela thinks the account is with Osaka. Since Mirela sent the message directly, Rania also thinks Mirela knows that Rania now attributes that belief to her. Rania learns nothing from the later calls, so the nested belief remains Osaka.

ANSWER: A

Oksana texted Emeka that the compass was in the grey locker. She doesn’t know he watched any later moves through the window, so she thinks he still believes it’s in the grey locker.

ANSWER: D

Uma, Bruno, and Viktor are all in the boathouse when Bruno makes the final move to the wicker basket. Uma can see that Bruno and Viktor are both there, so she thinks Bruno knows Viktor saw the move.

ANSWER: B

Jonas’s final change sets the product release to Friday. He tells nobody, but the change still takes effect.

ANSWER: D

Uma waits beside the green cupboard. It’s the last place she knows Emeka saw the compass before he left. She doesn’t know about the private texts or that he watched through the window, so she expects him to open the green cupboard first.

ANSWER: D

Hana’s last update is Farah’s direct message in step 12, which says the release is set for Friday. Hana doesn’t learn about any later changes.

ANSWER: A

Nadim hears Yara read out Thursday in step 10. He doesn’t learn about any later changes, so he honestly says Thursday.

ANSWER: C

At step 8, Farah tells Nadim the release is set for Friday. At step 10, Nadim secretly hears Yara read out Thursday, which replaces his belief that it was Friday. He learns of no later changes.

ANSWER: C

The last time Hana and Yara heard the release date together, it was Thursday. Farah later told Hana privately that it was Friday, but Hana never learned that Yara knew about that change. So Hana thinks Yara still believes the release is set for Thursday.

ANSWER: B

When Uma leaves, the compass is in the grey locker, and Oksana knows that Uma last saw it there. Emeka sees later moves through the window, but he does not see Uma return or Bruno make the final move. So Emeka still thinks Oksana believes Uma remembers the compass being in the grey locker.

ANSWER: B

Yara last saw Nadim learn the release date in step 6, when Jonas moved it to Thursday. She doesn’t know about Farah’s private message to Nadim or that he secretly listened to the later call. So Yara thinks Nadim still believes the release is set for Thursday.

ANSWER: C

Farah thinks Jonas believes Hana still has **Thursday** as the release day. Jonas and Hana both heard Thursday on call 10. Farah later told Hana privately that the release was on Friday, but she doesn’t know that Jonas saw the message.

ANSWER: D

Hana last heard Yara say the release was set for Thursday on call 10. Farah’s private message later tells Hana it’s Friday, but it doesn’t tell her what Yara knows. Hana also doesn’t know that Yara secretly saw Jonas move the release to Monday. So Hana expects Yara to say Thursday.

ANSWER: A

Tariq last moves the brooch to the tall tin. Wanjiru’s text describes its earlier location and does not change where it is.

ANSWER: D

Wanjiru saw the brooch in the flat tin through the window. She didn’t see Tariq move it to the tall tin, so she still thinks it’s in the flat tin.
